name: bg-neural
title: Neural Background
description: A full-bleed shader backdrop that draws thin luminous blue tendrils, brightening where they cross, over pure black. The pattern moves on its own and shifts toward the pointer.
use: A dark tech or AI page needs a living, glowing backdrop that reacts to the cursor.
avoid: It runs a WebGL loop every frame and reads the window pointer and scroll, so it reacts outside its own box.
a11y: Decorative shader canvas with no reduced-motion check, and it listens on the window for pointer and scroll. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black field holds a few delicate blue filaments that branch like veins or lightning, with small white-hot knots where strands converge. Everything fades to black at the edges, and a small white caption sits off-centre.
behaves: The strands crawl and re-form on a slow loop. Moving the pointer or scrolling pulls the glowing shape toward the cursor and alters its hue slightly.
customise: hue, saturation and chroma tune the colour and glow and className adds styles; the pattern itself and the pointer reaction are baked into the shader.
weight: heavy: A full-screen fragment shader with a fifteen-step loop, redrawn every frame.
